cards.owner: Sonnet worker; Silas (coordinator) runs the tests
cards.scope: Narrow fix: never treat a missing or failed signature lookup after blockhash expiry as proof that a transaction never landed.
cards.evidenceText: Gideon (Codex supervisor) source review found that, after a blockhash expired, a missing recent-cache status or a lookup error was recorded as never landed, so a landed funding transfer could have been sent twice. Fixed: lookups search transaction history, such records stay held as unknown and block execution, and only a later positive history result clears them, with a confirmed result restoring the once-only guard. The tool has no command to clear an unknown record. Gideon's (Codex supervisor) bounded independent closure review: PASS, local source and test boundary only. It found no blocking issue, read the zero-additional-send regressions and matched the test-summary hash. Gideon (Codex supervisor) did not re-run the tests; the coordinator's local runs are the test evidence. No approval implied.
